rationale: run_git_sentinel retries every nonzero git commit with --no-verify, without classifying why it failed or obtaining a policy override. Thus a pre-commit/commit-msg rejection can be bypassed by the automatic retry. Objective/milestone/status/iteration mutations call this helper. This confirms the reachable bypass path, not execution of an actual commit.

source_checks.observation: Any nonzero first commit triggers hook-disabled retry.
Objective mutation invokes sentinel after saving state.

rationale: The helper runs git add . at repository root and commits the resulting full index. Callers only intend objective YAML/project synchronization, so unrelated nonignored new files, tracked changes and pre-staged changes can be included. There is no scoped pathspec or index isolation. This is separate from the hook retry defect.
